what: Franklin Templeton manages money. It runs mutual funds, exchange-traded funds and institutional portfolios across equities, bonds and alternatives, and has bought several specialist managers including Western Asset and Legg Mason.
customers: Individual investors through advisers, retirement plans, and institutional clients worldwide.
moat: A broad set of specialist investment firms under one roof, with distribution relationships across advisers and institutions built over decades.
risks: Investigations and outflows at Western Asset cost it a large amount of fixed income assets
Money keeps moving from active funds to index funds
Return on invested capital of about 6% reflects acquisition goodwill
opportunities: A dividend yield near 4% with cash exceeding debt
Alternative and private market strategies grow faster and charge higher fees
watch: Net client flows excluding Western Asset, and the average fee rate.
